title: Master data foundation checkpoint after first Location and Customer
purpose: Classify the current Universaarl master-data foundation before another write: Location and Customer are proven, Vendor is blocked by U-VEND Manual Nos., and Item remains higher-risk until its setup fields are deliberately scoped.
entryCriteria: TARGET-036D2E/D2F keep U-VEND Manual Nos. and first vendor blocked.
No item write gate has been run yet.
acceptanceCriteria: Location, Customer, Vendor and Item readiness are classified separately.
Vendor remains blocked unless U-VEND Manual Nos. is later proven active.
Item is not created in this checkpoint.
The next write gate is selected with lookahead and risk rationale.
Preview Posting and Posting remain false.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: D2F parks the U-VEND Manual Nos. recovery because repeated list/checkbox routes did not prove the field active after reopen.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Vendor creation is still blocked; the next practical step is a no-write checkpoint before selecting another master-data write route.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: No write and directly clarifies readiness after the first Location and Customer.
May be sensible after checkpoint if item setup and required fields are scoped.
May be better than item creation if the checkpoint shows a setup blocker should be fixed first.
Requires item/customer/posting/VAT readiness and must not precede foundation.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It prevents another premature write and gives the book a clear explanation of what first master data really exists.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not convert this checkpoint into a live write.
Do not claim vendor or item readiness.
